### Design Background
Bazzaal Box brings the best of K-Beauty to the world through creator-led curations. Unlike traditional subscription services, Bazzaal operates on a "drop" model, requiring a versatile "one-size-fits-all" design system that adapts to diverse product lineups for every launch. I designed a packaging identity that ensures a share-worthy unboxing experience while maintaining structural durability for international shipping, regardless of the collection's theme.

### Introduction
The 10,000 Buddha Relics Exhibition is the largest display of Buddhist treasures in the United States, established in 2013. The collection features a vast array of sacred relics sourced from various Asian countries, including Myanmar, Thailand, Sri Lanka, and Vietnam. To ensure an accessible experience for international visitors, translation services and materials are provided in six languages: English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, and Spanish.

### Key Takeaways

This project ran on tight collaboration: strategy set the direction, creative gave it shape, and media and store operations carried it live. From Sep 2025 to Dec 2025, I worked on 80+ emails, plus the storefront and paid media visuals.

Each send came back with numbers, and those numbers shaped the next one. That loop of designing, reading, adjusting became the real skill I took from this project: how to find out what works, not just guess at it.
Brand Identity & ChiMi Chess Knight Packaging

### Design Background
MUGUHADA was founded to share the understated beauty of Korea with the world. Rather than treating cultural heritage as something to simply observe, the brand reinterprets it through contemporary design and creates objects that can be held, moved, and experienced in everyday life.

### Design Direction
I created MUGUHADA's brand identity and extended it into the ChiMi Chess Knight packaging system. Moving beyond the simple reproduction of traditional ornament, I refined Korean architectural rooflines, floral details, and geometric patterns into a clean contemporary language. Jade and warm orange balance restraint with a playful character, while the modular boxes form connected scenes when rearranged. This carries the brand narrative from the object itself through its display and unboxing experience.
